name: terminal-line-plot
title_zh: 终端里直接画 ASCII 折线图，不弹窗口不落文件
tagline_zh: 数值、CSV、JSON、命令输出都能喂。曲线、趋势、排行榜进度一眼可见，聊天记录里自带图表，不用截图不用开图。
tagline_en: Feed it numbers, CSV, JSON, or command output. Trends, curves, score progress render inline—no screenshots, no.
desc_en: Draw readable ASCII line charts directly in the terminal from numeric series, command output, CSV, JSON, or manually extracted points. Use when the user asks for a curve, trend line, score progression, leaderboard trend, metric history, or any plot that should be visible in a CLI/chat transcript without opening a GUI or writing image files.
why_zh: 把数据变成能留在终端里的图，而不是一闪而过的窗口。适合复盘、汇报、调试时直接贴进对话。
why_en: Turns data into charts that live in your terminal—not a window that vanishes. Paste them straight into chats or logs, no.
limit_zh: 只画折线图，不画柱状、饼图、散点。输入得是数值序列或可解析的表格，非数值字段会报错。图表宽度受终端列数限制。
limit_en: Line charts only—no bars, pies, or scatter. Needs numeric series or parseable tables; non-numeric fields error out. Width capped by terminal.
title_en: ASCII line charts in your terminal, no GUI or files
